system.description:
Trigger: You start a Player Phase with 8 Ichor.

You gain the following benefits until the end of the Round.

  • Your Armament gains +1 Range
  • Bleeding Ichor generates 2 Ichor instead of 1 when you deal damage
  • Ichor can be expended for a burst of movement. Gain +3 Movement per 1 Ichor consumed this way.
  • If you are dealt damage while Impending Doom is active, you can immediately unleash your Focused Attack against the enemy who attacked you.
